about: Showcasing the best blend of jungle, footwork, breakbeat and a few classics thrown in.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 22 Dec. DJ, producer and soundsystem operator V.I.V.E.K takes over the Sweatbox, bringing 30 minutes of dub-tinged club music to get your bassbin shaking. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with V.I.V.E.K

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 22 Dec. A healthy dose of sub-bass in this show as SHERELLE plays tracks from Mantra, Jonny L, Stevie Hyper D, Calibre and more. Whether you’re dancing at home, on the move or getting ready for a night out, let SHERELLE soundtrack your Saturday night with the best music across the rave continuum. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Shackout

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. Pioneering British techno musician Dave Angel brings a deep techno energy to the Sweatbox. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Dave Angel

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 15 Dec. Sounds combining jazz, house and techno dominate this show as SHERELLE soundtracks Saturday night. Featuring music from Jeff Mills, Juan Atkins, DJ Deeon, Skee Mask and more. SHERELLE also dives into music from this week’s Sweatbox guest, Dave Angel, selecting tracks from his new album A Time and Place. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: Down deep

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 8 Dec. London-via-Los Angeles DJ and producer Carré brings her bass-heavy sounds to the Sweatbox. Celebrating a recent EP release on British dubstep label Tempa, Carré weaves between leftfield techno, bass and more in this atmospheric mix. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Carré

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 8 Dec. SHERELLE invites rising Swedish singer, songwriter and producer DJ Suzy into the Cab. DJ Suzy’s music sits between alternative R&B, dream-pop and electronic influences, and SHERELLE sets the scene accordingly with music from Tirzah and Jadu Heart. Later in the show, the music ramps up as the Sweatbox draws closer. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: DJ Suzy in the Cab to the Club

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec. One for your bass bins: dubstep legend Coki enters the Sweatbox for Halloween, providing 30 minutes of head-rattling bass music. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: The Sweatbox - with Coki

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 1 Dec. SHERELLE gets spooky for Halloween, playing the deepest, darkest dubstep in her arsenal! Expect tunes from Mala, multiple appearances from Kahn and Joker, with some haunting sounds along the way... Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 6 Music.
items.title: It's Halloween! Let's Listen To Dubstep!

name: SHERELLE
